sourceReason: The unnumbered statement in §1, p. 1 of arXiv:2609.00419v1 extends the one-or-infinity dichotomy to nonrecursive many-one degrees with a co-c.e. representative. The article applies this case in the proof of Corollary 7 on p. 14. The type uses mathlib’s many-one degree quotient and REPred for computable enumerability on ℕ. The article-specific Alphabeta Math Research Portal and designated defect report both returned HTTP 404.
